mentions.name: pictureCram
mentions.description: This is a browser-based image annotation and review tool for detection and categorization tasks, built as a simplified clone of CVAT and LabelStudio, with plans to eventually expand it into an end-to-end solution.
mentions.problem: Managing training datasets was annoying, prompting a simplified alternative to CVAT and LabelStudio.
mentions.source_excerpt: Managing the training datasets was annoying enough that I created my own simplified clone of CVAT and LabelStudio : a browser-based image annotation and review tool for detection + categorization. Will eventually expand this to an end-to-end solution.
